hypothesis: There exists at least one venue and execution mode (maker-only or taker) on which the measured round-trip cost of trading BTC, ETH or SOL perpetuals is low enough that a gross edge of the size P0 observed (0.78 bps microstructure, 1.97 bps cross-exchange) clears the three-times cost wall.
economic_reason: This is a cost measurement, not a return hypothesis. The agent is the liquidity taker or provider on each venue; the constraint is the published fee schedule plus the spread, the adverse selection borne by a resting order and the probability that it fills before the quote moves. Nothing here predicts a return, so nothing here is a look at a target, and no multiplicity trial is charged: the family field names the terrain being measured.

entry_rule.measurement: resting order at the best bid or ask, end of queue

exit_rule.measurement: mid price after the adverse-selection window

cost_model.notes: Placeholders required by the schema. This mechanism MEASURES these quantities per venue; it does not consume them.

validation_window.nature: measurement window: three full days of L1 quotes and trades; no target, no look

declustering_rule.note: not used: there is no event series to decluster

notes: Standalone measurement. run.py is NOT executed through research_kernel.run_mechanism and records no trial in any family. Bybit is not collected on disk: only its published fees appear, no measured spread or latency. L1 only: slippage beyond the touch is not measurable, only the notional available at the touch.
